title: Case timing parts
description: The timing campaign's parts a case provides (MiSArch: timing/parts.json, versions 2 and 3; timing/RESULTS.md §12): per domain operation its own CPU and per (class, mode) access its database CPU, mapping CPU and statements, measured on today's cut; the at-load scale k_c per container and the order path's cardinality term. Read by core/generator/derive.py class Timing (and Envelope for `envelope` in version 3). Operations without parts fall back to the domain's seed demands. Also carries (not read by the generator): schema, analysis, counters, generatedBy, domainCommit, windows, requests, fits, middleware, kDb, kAtLoadNoCardinality, overheadOnVsOff, overheadRatios, orderPathCardinality, rateSensitivity, mechanisms, perExecution, rareOperations.

version.description: Format version; the generator reads 2 and 3 (derive Timing.VERSIONS). 3 moves the per-request rest into byRequest[].requestOverheadCpuMs and may carry `envelope`.

kAtLoad.description: container (<service>, <service>-db, ...) -> at-load scale k_c; default 1 (derive Timing.kof).

kAtLoadDetail.description: Detail of the k_c estimate. Also carries (not read by the generator): containers, levels, factorial, maxLevel, window.

cardinalityMsPerOrder.description: container -> ms per order of the order path's cardinality term (<service>: app, <service>-db: DB; -dapr and -ecs sidecars are skipped) (derive Timing.__init__).

envelope.description: Version 3: the envelope (derive Envelope, schema #/$defs/envelope); in version 2 it is ignored and timing/envelope-estimate-v2.json is read instead.

handler.description: A handler (reaction) of the timing campaign, by operation id. Also carries (not read by the generator): topic, types, envelopeCpuMs, envelopeParts, from, flag, workFrom, idempotencyCheck, countersRemainderCpuMs.

service.description: Service of the handler (derive Envelope.by_svc: pooled envelope per service).

envelopeAppCpuMs.description: App-side envelope CPU ms (dispatch, decode, idempotency, transaction) (derive Envelope.share, pooled).

workCpuMs.description: Work CPU ms (business logic and statements); must be a number for a handler of a reaction the workload reaches (derive Envelope.share).

callee.description: Callee envelope of a synchronous invocation of a service. Also carries (not read by the generator): dispatchCpuMs, decodeCpuMs, txCpuMs, types, flag.

envelopeAppCpuMs.description: Envelope CPU ms; ignored unless a number (derive Envelope.callee).

envelope.description: The receiving envelope of an effect step (timing/README.md §6). Also carries (not read by the generator): schema, version, source, flag, units, senders, requestOverhead, hopsMs, rows.

callees.description: service -> callee envelope (derive Envelope.callee; else the service's handler mean, else all handlers' mean).

access.description: The campaign's parts of one (class, mode) access of the operation.

class.description: Domain class (derive Timing.access: matched by class and mode, the first entry).

dbMs.description: Database-container CPU ms per execution, x k_c of <service>-db (derive Timing.access; the order path's DB cardinality term goes on the first access with dbMs > 0).

mapCpuMs.description: App-side mapping CPU ms per execution, x k_c of the service (derive Timing.access).

calls.description: Measured statements per execution (derive Timing.access: latency waits, commits).

rows.description: Measured rows over all statements (derive Timing.access, default 0: Access.rows per statement).

byRequest.description: The operation's parts within one request type. Also carries (not read by the generator): accesses, ownShareOfService, totals.

ownCpuMs.description: Own CPU ms in this request (derive Timing.demand when the operation is the request's root).

requestOverheadCpuMs.description: Version 3: the service's per-request rest, charged to the request's root resolver (derive Timing.demand, uncharged_overhead; default 0).

operation.description: The campaign's parts of one domain operation. Also carries (not read by the generator): service, kind, followUps, approximateTotals, totalsFrom.

ownCpuMs.description: Own CPU ms per execution before k_c (derive Timing.demand, cardinality candidates).

accesses.description: Per (class, mode) parts (derive Timing.access, cardinality candidates).

byRequest.description: request type -> parts in that request, per execution of the operation (MiSArch: executionsPerRequest per request; requestOverheadCpuMs per request) (derive Timing.demand, uncharged_overhead).

measuredIn.description: Request types it was measured in; createOrder/placeOrder ones may carry the order path's cardinality term (derive Timing.__init__).
